categories.main_business_segments: Jiangxi GETO New Materials Corporation Limited primarily operates in the building materials sector focusing on aluminum formwork systems, attached climbing safety platforms, and prefabricated concrete (PC) components for assembly buildings. The company integrates research, design, production, sales, leasing, and technical services, offering a comprehensive '1+N' one-stop service model. Its business segments include aluminum formwork sales and leasing, safety platform leasing, and prefabricated PC component sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced aluminum alloy extrusion and steel materials for manufacturing formwork components through processes such as cutting, punching, and welding. It employs automated production lines including CNC cutting, hydraulic punching, and robotic welding to ensure precision and efficiency. The firm also develops proprietary BIM-based software for intelligent design and optimization of formwork systems, enhancing customization and reducing onsite modifications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large construction contractors, real estate developers, and infrastructure project operators primarily in the building and civil engineering sectors. The company serves domestic markets extensively, especially in major Chinese urban regions, and has expanded into international markets including Southeast Asia and the Middle East. Its products are used in residential, commercial, public infrastructure, and industrial construction projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with significant presence in provinces such as Jiangxi, Guangdong, Hainan, Shandong, and Chongqing. It also has subsidiaries and business operations in Malaysia, Singapore, Cambodia, and other countries in Southeast Asia, supporting its international expansion strategy aligned with the Belt and Road Initiative.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangxi GETO New Materials is positioned midstream in the construction materials supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and leasing of aluminum formwork and safety platforms, as well as producing prefabricated concrete components. It controls design, production, and technical services, supplying directly to construction contractors and developers, thus operating primarily as a manufacturer and service provider rather than raw material supplier or end-user.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in intelligent design using BIM technology, automation in production processes, and expanding product applications to complex and high-rise structures. R&D focuses include developing automated climbing formwork systems, modular prefabricated building components, and safety-enhancing climbing platforms. It invests in digital management systems and integrates AI and IoT technologies to build a full-industry chain ecosystem supporting green and smart building transformations.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through product sales, leasing services, and technical support. Aluminum formwork and safety platforms are offered both for sale and rental, with rental income based on actual usage area and contract pricing. Prefabricated concrete components are primarily sold. Additional revenue streams include entrusted refurbishment services for used formwork and sales of scrap materials.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in the Chinese aluminum formwork and building materials industry, recognized as a top-tier enterprise with national high-tech status and industry association leadership roles. It competes with numerous small and medium-sized enterprises in a fragmented market but maintains competitive advantages through scale, technology, and comprehensive service capabilities. Its international certifications and brand presence further distinguish it from competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.24 billion, marking a 16% increase year-over-year. Despite revenue growth, it experienced a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 45 million, influenced by market demand fluctuations and pricing pressures. The company has expanded production capacity and diversified product lines, with ongoing investments in R&D and international market development, indicating a growth-oriented but currently challenged financial profile.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangxi GETO New Materials offers high-precision, durable, and lightweight aluminum formwork systems that improve construction efficiency and concrete surface quality, supporting green building initiatives. Its integrated service model provides end-to-end solutions including design, production, leasing, and technical support, enhancing customer convenience and project outcomes. The company’s advanced automation and intelligent design capabilities enable customized solutions, while its safety platforms contribute to safer high-rise construction environments, collectively differentiating it in the market.
